concerns.text: FR-003 (Bonferroni Correction) lacks a dedicated implementation task. T019 is marked [X] (failed/rejected) in the analyze report, meaning the logic to apply Bonferroni correction to p-values is not present in the task list to be executed.

FR-004 (Effect Size Calculation) lacks a dedicated implementation task. T020 is marked [X] (failed/rejected) in the analyze report. While T018 mentions effect sizes, there is no specific task to calculate Cohen's d and 95% CIs as required by FR-004.

FR-006 (MMSE Exclusion) is not fully covered. T012e is marked [X] (failed/rejected). The task to filter participants with MMSE < 24 and generate the required output files (`cleaned_dataset.csv`, `exclusion_log.json`) is missing from the executable task list.

FR-002/US2 robustness requires error handling for zero variance/small samples. T023 is marked [X] (failed/rejected). There is no active task to implement the error handling logic mandated by the spec's robustness goals.
FR-007 (Runtime Monitoring) is not covered. T035b is marked [X] (failed/rejected). The task to implement the 6-hour runtime warning logic is missing from the executable list.

Plan Phase 1 elements (Data Model generation, Contract generation) are not covered. T020b-1 and T020a-1 are marked [X] (failed/rejected). The plan requires these artifacts to exist before Phase 2, but the tasks to generate them are not active.

Plan elements (README, Quickstart) are not covered. T031a and T020c are marked [X] (failed/rejected). The plan mandates these for reproducibility (Constitution Principle I), but the tasks are not active.
Task T014a is marked [ ] (pending) but has a comment 'FAILED: unspecified'. This indicates a stale or broken task state that needs to be resolved or removed to prevent confusion.
